correctness.rationale: Taking affine t=Y/Z and x=X/Z gives Kummer extension x^6=-t(t^4+beta t²+1). The cited Badr–Bars theorem supplies full G=C3×D8 of order24 and N=<sigma²> of order6. With residual V4 action t→-t and t→1/t, the invariant fixed field is C(t²+t^-2); degree is 6×4=24. Kummer ramification index6 at t=0,∞ and 4 roots of t^4+beta t²+1; the degree4 base map has index2 at t=0,∞ and ±1,±i. For beta≠±2, combined inertia orders at u=∞,-beta,2,-2 are (12,6,2,2); orbit sizes 24/e=(2,4,12,12). Calculated discriminant of quartic as 16(beta-2)²(beta+2)² and tame Riemann–Hurwitz 24(-2+11/12+5/6+1)=18=2g-2 for g=10. Independent sympy validation of branch-polynomial identities and Riemann–Hurwitz; this is symbolic in beta, not finite sampling. Exceptional beta loci excluded exactly as stated.
